include_kernel.description: v0.2 §4.2: when true, include _kernel-scope records in results. Default false.

include_cancelled.description: v1.1 §3.10 (Block 4.6 / BLOCK-4.5-SPEC-AMENDMENTS Appendix A item 7): when true, cancelled (I, R)s are included in results. Default false (cancelled records are excluded to avoid surprising callers; explicit opt-in to see them). An explicit `status: ['cancelled']` filter overrides this gate (caller intent wins per Block 4.6 Q2): if cancelled is in the status filter, cancelled records are returned regardless of include_cancelled.
